capabilities: Reorder cards by drag and save the order in a number property
Compact card display and hide empty properties
Open a card's note in an editable popup over the board
Collapse columns and fit column height to its cards
Move cards to any column from the context menu
disambiguation: Not a standalone Kanban plugin; it only enhances Obsidian's built-in Bases Kanban boards and adds no separate view.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.0 or newer on desktop and mobile. The plugin hooks into Kanban internals, so a future Obsidian change may make affected features fall back to native behaviour. No network requests. Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: It extends Obsidian's built-in Bases Kanban layout and does not add a separate view.
problem: Obsidian's native Bases Kanban layout lacks manual card ordering, compact card sizing, collapsible columns and a quick way to view a card's note without leaving the board.

relations.evidence: The guarded drag adapter and rollback approach are adapted from Bases Kanban Companion, copyright 2026 wjsyuwls, MIT.

summary: Adds manual card order, compact cards, collapsible columns, card popups and other refinements to Obsidian's built-in Bases Kanban boards.
